title_en: Why Koreans press this button non-stop #shorts
description_en: Every Korean elevator has a close button, and almost nobody waits for the doors. The reason is one word: ppalli-ppalli. Learn 빨리빨리, 배달 (delivery) and 닫힘 (close). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
hook_en: Why do Koreans spam this button?

hook_id: Kenapa orang Korea tekan tombol ini terus?
hook_es: ¿Por qué los coreanos pulsan tanto este botón?
hook_pt: Por que os coreanos apertam tanto este botão?
hook_ar: لماذا يضغط الكوريون هذا الزر مرارًا؟
hook_fil: Bakit paulit-ulit pinipindot ng mga Korean ang button na ito?
